methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 8 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $3.2B - $39.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Applied Intuition, a Series F AI & Software company, is the subject of this valuation analysis. The target operates within a competitive frontier-tech sector represented by a comp universe of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), spanning valuation tiers from $3.25B to $39.0B. The company has raised $600M+ to date.

Stage-progression methodology was deemed inapplicable; the reported $15.0B post-money valuation implies a multiple exceeding 20x total capital raised, suggesting a data integrity issue with the funding-tracker source. Peer-median triangulation was therefore the primary applicable method. Across 8 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier private companies—including Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Scale AI ($29.0B, Series B), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), and Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C)—the median valuation is $12.0B, with a range of $3.2B to $39.0B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10.2B to $13.8B, centered on a $12.0B median. Key uncertainties include the reliability of the current $15.0B valuation assertion and variance in comparable company growth trajectories and capital efficiency across the AI & Software sector. The single-method reliance reflects limited applicability of stage-progression given data quality constraints.
